items.question: Which additional goddess forms are named in this stage of the enumeration?
premises: The verse names Navadurgā as a goddess form.
The verse names Mātaṅgī as another goddess form.
Mātaṅgī is characterized as worshipped by the sage Mataṅga.
items.inference: Navadurgā and Mātaṅgī, the latter worshipped by the sage Mataṅga, are included among the enumerated goddess forms.
items.plain_english: Also named are the nine Durgās and Mātaṅgī, who is worshipped by the sage Mataṅga.
